title: Neuron Reconstruction Parquet Metadata
description: Metadata encoded as the value of the nr key in a neuron-reconstruction Parquet file.

atlas_annotation_set.description: Identifier and version of the atlas annotation set used for the reconstruction. Empty when no annotations are assigned.

atlas_coordinate_space.description: Identifier and version of the atlas coordinate space used for the reconstruction. Empty when the reconstruction is not registered to an atlas.

subject_id.description: Unique identifier for the subject from which the cell was obtained.

cell_id.description: Unique identifier for the reconstructed cell.

annotator.description: Name or names of the people who created the reconstruction annotation.

peer_reviewer.description: Name or names of the peer reviewers who assessed the reconstruction.

proofreader.description: Name or names of the people who proofread the reconstruction.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier associated with the reconstruction (specific version).

doi_cell.description: Digital Object Identifier associated with the cell across reconstruction versions.

date.description: Date and time the reconstruction was created, formatted according to ISO 8601.

label_fluorophore.description: Fluorophore used to label the reconstructed cell.

label_virus.description: Viral construct used to label the reconstructed cell.
